title: Dan and Daria's Treasure Hunt
recap: Dan and Daria's flashlight stopped working in the dark.

slides.text: On Saturday, Daria went to see Dan.
They were in Dan’s backyard for a treasure hunt.
It got dark and the flashlight would not turn on.
Daria asked Dan’s mom for a battery.
Dan’s mom put the battery in the flashlight so they could see and find the treasure.
